tech.name: Python
tech.notes: General-purpose, dynamically typed; the default language of data and machine-learning work.

tech.name: TypeScript
tech.notes: A typed superset of JavaScript that compiles to JavaScript; used on both the browser and Node.js.

tech.name: JavaScript
tech.notes: The language every browser runs; also runs on servers through Node.js, Deno and Bun.

tech.name: Go
tech.notes: Compiled, statically typed, garbage collected; builds single static binaries and has goroutines for concurrency.

tech.name: Java
tech.notes: Runs on the JVM; OpenJDK is the reference implementation. Long-term-support releases every two years.

tech.name: Kotlin
tech.notes: JVM language fully interoperable with Java; Google's preferred language for Android.

tech.name: Swift
tech.notes: Apple's compiled language for iOS, macOS and other Apple platforms; also runs on Linux.

tech.name: C#
tech.notes: Statically typed language of .NET; .NET is open source and cross-platform.

tech.name: Rust
tech.notes: Compiled with no garbage collector; memory safety is checked at compile time by the borrow checker.

tech.name: Ruby
tech.notes: Dynamically typed, object-oriented; best known through Ruby on Rails.

tech.name: PHP
tech.notes: Server-side scripting language; runs a large share of the web through WordPress and Laravel.

tech.name: Elixir
tech.notes: Functional language on the Erlang VM (BEAM): lightweight processes and supervision trees for fault tolerance.

tech.name: Dart
tech.notes: Google's client-optimised language; compiles ahead of time to native code and to JavaScript. Flutter's language.

tech.name: Node.js
tech.notes: JavaScript runtime built on V8 with an event loop for non-blocking I/O; even-numbered releases get long-term support.

tech.name: Bun
tech.notes: JavaScript runtime, bundler, test runner and package manager in one binary; aims at Node.js compatibility.

tech.name: React
tech.notes: Component library for user interfaces; a view layer, so routing and data fetching come from other libraries or a framework.

tech.name: Vue
tech.notes: Progressive framework with single-file components and a reactivity system; official router and state library.

tech.name: Svelte
tech.notes: Compiles components to plain JavaScript at build time rather than shipping a runtime virtual DOM.

tech.name: Angular
tech.notes: Full framework from Google: router, forms, HTTP client and dependency injection included; opinionated structure.

tech.name: SolidJS
tech.notes: JSX components with fine-grained reactive signals and no virtual DOM.

tech.name: Next.js
tech.notes: React framework with file-based routing, server rendering, React Server Components and API routes.

tech.name: Nuxt
tech.notes: Vue framework with file-based routing, server rendering and a server engine (Nitro) for API routes.

tech.name: SvelteKit
tech.notes: Svelte's application framework: routing, server rendering, form actions and deployment adapters.

tech.name: Remix / React Router
tech.notes: Loaders and actions over web fetch APIs; Remix's framework features merged into React Router v7.

tech.name: Astro
tech.notes: Content-focused site builder that ships zero JavaScript by default and hydrates interactive 'islands' only.

tech.name: Vite
tech.notes: Dev server with native ES modules and fast hot reload; production builds bundled with Rollup/Rolldown.

tech.name: Tailwind CSS
tech.notes: Utility-first CSS: styles are composed from small classes and unused ones are left out of the build.

tech.name: shadcn/ui
tech.notes: Accessible React components copied into your own code by a CLI rather than installed as a dependency.

tech.name: TanStack Query
tech.notes: Server-state caching for the browser: fetching, caching, background refetch and invalidation.

tech.name: Redux Toolkit
tech.notes: The official way to write Redux: slices, immutable updates and RTK Query for data fetching.

tech.name: Pinia
tech.notes: Vue's official state store, replacing Vuex.

tech.name: htmx
tech.notes: Adds AJAX, WebSocket and server-sent-event behaviour to HTML attributes; the server returns HTML fragments.

tech.name: Hugo
tech.notes: Static site generator written in Go; a single binary that builds large sites quickly from Markdown.

tech.name: Electron
tech.notes: Desktop apps from web code: Chromium and Node.js bundled together, so installers are large (tens of MB).

tech.name: Tauri
tech.notes: Desktop and mobile apps with a web front end on the system webview and a Rust core; small installers.

tech.name: electron-builder
tech.notes: Packages Electron apps into installers (dmg, nsis, AppImage) with code signing and auto-update support.

tech.name: Storybook
tech.notes: Workshop for building and documenting UI components in isolation.

tech.name: React Native
tech.notes: Native iOS and Android apps from React components rendered to native views.

tech.name: Expo
tech.notes: Toolkit and SDK around React Native: managed native modules, file-based routing, over-the-air updates.

tech.name: EAS (Expo Application Services)
tech.notes: Hosted builds, app store submission and over-the-air updates for Expo apps; paid tiers above a free allowance.

tech.name: Flutter
tech.notes: Google's UI toolkit that draws its own widgets; one Dart codebase for iOS, Android, web and desktop.

tech.name: SwiftUI
tech.notes: Apple's declarative UI framework for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS and visionOS; ships with Apple's SDKs.

tech.name: Jetpack Compose
tech.notes: Android's declarative UI toolkit in Kotlin.

tech.name: Kotlin Multiplatform
tech.notes: Shares Kotlin business logic across Android, iOS, desktop and server while keeping native UIs where wanted.

tech.name: Capacitor
tech.notes: Wraps a web app in a native iOS/Android shell with plugins for device APIs (from the Ionic team).

tech.name: fastlane
tech.notes: Automates iOS and Android builds, signing, screenshots and store releases.

tech.name: FastAPI
tech.notes: Async Python web framework; request and response models are Pydantic types and the OpenAPI document is generated from them.

tech.name: Pydantic
tech.notes: Data validation from Python type hints; the core is written in Rust.

tech.name: Django
tech.notes: Batteries-included Python framework: ORM, migrations, admin, auth and templates.

tech.name: Django REST framework
tech.notes: Serializers, viewsets, authentication and a browsable API for Django.

tech.name: Flask
tech.notes: Minimal Python web framework (WSGI); extensions add what the core leaves out.

tech.name: SQLAlchemy
tech.notes: Python SQL toolkit and ORM with sync and async sessions.

tech.name: Alembic
tech.notes: Schema migrations for SQLAlchemy, with autogenerate from models.

tech.name: Express
tech.notes: Minimal Node.js web framework built on middleware.

tech.name: NestJS
tech.notes: Structured Node.js framework with modules, dependency injection and decorators; runs on Express or Fastify.

tech.name: Fastify
tech.notes: Node.js web framework with JSON-schema validation and a plugin system; built for low overhead.

tech.name: Hono
tech.notes: Small web framework on web-standard Request/Response; runs on Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Bun and Node.js.

tech.name: Elysia
tech.notes: TypeScript web framework designed for Bun, with end-to-end type inference.

tech.name: tRPC
tech.notes: Typesafe APIs between a TypeScript server and client without a schema file or code generation.

tech.name: Prisma
tech.notes: TypeScript ORM with a schema file, generated client and migrations.

tech.name: Drizzle ORM
tech.notes: TypeScript ORM whose queries read like SQL; schema defined in TypeScript.

tech.name: Spring Boot
tech.notes: Opinionated Spring setup: auto-configuration, embedded server, production endpoints (Actuator).

tech.name: Quarkus
tech.notes: Java framework tuned for containers: fast start and low memory, including GraalVM native images.

tech.name: ASP.NET Core
tech.notes: Cross-platform .NET web framework: minimal APIs, MVC, SignalR for realtime.

tech.name: Entity Framework Core
tech.notes: .NET ORM with LINQ queries and migrations.

tech.name: Gin
tech.notes: Go HTTP framework with a fast router and middleware.

tech.name: Echo
tech.notes: Minimal Go web framework: router, middleware, data binding.

tech.name: chi
tech.notes: Lightweight Go router that stays compatible with the standard library's net/http.

tech.name: gRPC
tech.notes: RPC over HTTP/2 with Protocol Buffers contracts; generated clients and servers in many languages.

tech.name: Axum
tech.notes: Rust web framework from the Tokio project, built on tower middleware.

tech.name: Tokio
tech.notes: Asynchronous runtime for Rust: scheduler, I/O, timers.

tech.name: Actix Web
tech.notes: Rust web framework on the actix runtime.

tech.name: Ruby on Rails
tech.notes: Convention-over-configuration framework: ActiveRecord, migrations, Action Cable, background jobs.

tech.name: Hotwire (Turbo + Stimulus)
tech.notes: Server-rendered HTML sent over the wire, with Turbo for navigation/streams and Stimulus for small behaviours.

tech.name: Laravel
tech.notes: PHP framework: Eloquent ORM, queues, scheduler, Blade templates.

tech.name: Phoenix
tech.notes: Elixir web framework with Channels and LiveView for realtime server-rendered UI.

tech.name: Socket.IO
tech.notes: Realtime bidirectional events over WebSocket with fallback, rooms and reconnection; needs its own client.

tech.name: Typer
tech.notes: Builds command-line interfaces from Python type hints (on top of Click).

tech.name: Click
tech.notes: Python package for composable command-line interfaces.

tech.name: Cobra
tech.notes: Go library for CLIs with subcommands, flags and generated help and completions.

tech.name: clap
tech.notes: Rust command-line argument parser with derive macros.

tech.name: OpenAPI
tech.notes: A machine-readable description of an HTTP API; clients, docs and tests can be generated from it.

tech.name: PostgreSQL
tech.notes: Relational database with transactions, JSONB, full-text search and a large extension ecosystem.

tech.name: MySQL
tech.notes: Relational database from Oracle; the InnoDB engine gives transactions and row locking.

tech.name: MariaDB
tech.notes: Community fork of MySQL, largely compatible with it.

tech.name: SQLite
tech.notes: Embedded SQL database in a single file; no server process. One writer at a time.

tech.name: MongoDB
tech.notes: Document database storing BSON documents; multi-document transactions since 4.0.

tech.name: Apache Cassandra
tech.notes: Wide-column store for very large write-heavy workloads across data centres; queries are designed around partition keys.

tech.name: ClickHouse
tech.notes: Column-oriented database for analytical queries over very large tables.

tech.name: DuckDB
tech.notes: In-process analytical SQL database; reads Parquet, CSV and Arrow directly.

tech.name: Amazon DynamoDB
tech.notes: AWS's managed key-value and document database; on-demand or provisioned capacity; access patterns must be designed up front.

tech.name: Cloud Firestore
tech.notes: Google's managed document database with realtime listeners and offline client caches.

tech.name: Supabase
tech.notes: Hosted Postgres with auth, storage, realtime and generated APIs; can be self-hosted.

tech.name: Neon
tech.notes: Serverless Postgres that separates storage from compute, with branching and scale to zero.

tech.name: TimescaleDB
tech.notes: Postgres extension for time-series data: hypertables, compression, continuous aggregates.

tech.name: Neo4j
tech.notes: Graph database queried with Cypher.

tech.name: pgvector
tech.notes: Postgres extension for vector similarity search with HNSW and IVFFlat indexes.

tech.name: Qdrant
tech.notes: Vector database with payload filtering; runs self-hosted or as a managed cloud.

tech.name: Amazon S3
tech.notes: Object storage; many other providers (R2, MinIO, GCS) offer an S3-compatible API.

tech.name: MinIO
tech.notes: Self-hosted S3-compatible object storage.

tech.name: Redis
tech.notes: In-memory data structure store: cache, rate limits, pub/sub and streams. Licensed AGPL/RSAL/SSPL since 8.0.

tech.name: Valkey
tech.notes: Linux Foundation fork of Redis 7.2, wire-compatible, under the BSD licence.

tech.name: Memcached
tech.notes: Simple distributed in-memory key-value cache; no persistence.

tech.name: Apache Kafka
tech.notes: Distributed, partitioned, replicated log; consumers keep their own offsets, so events can be replayed.

tech.name: RabbitMQ
tech.notes: Message broker speaking AMQP: exchanges, routing keys, acknowledgements; also has streams.

tech.name: NATS
tech.notes: Lightweight messaging (pub/sub, request/reply); JetStream adds persistence and at-least-once delivery.

tech.name: Amazon SQS
tech.notes: Managed message queues from AWS: standard (at-least-once) and FIFO.

tech.name: Google Cloud Pub/Sub
tech.notes: Managed publish/subscribe messaging on Google Cloud.

tech.name: Celery
tech.notes: Python distributed task queue; workers take jobs from a broker such as RabbitMQ or Redis.

tech.name: Sidekiq
tech.notes: Background jobs for Ruby on threads, backed by Redis; paid Pro/Enterprise editions add features.

tech.name: BullMQ
tech.notes: Node.js job queue on Redis: delays, retries, rate limits, flows.

tech.name: Temporal
tech.notes: Durable workflow engine: workflow code is replayed from history so it survives crashes and retries.

tech.name: Elasticsearch
tech.notes: Distributed search and analytics engine on Lucene.

tech.name: OpenSearch
tech.notes: Apache-licensed fork of Elasticsearch 7.10, run by the Linux Foundation.

tech.name: OpenSearch Dashboards
tech.notes: Visualisation and query UI for OpenSearch.

tech.name: Kibana
tech.notes: Visualisation and query UI for Elasticsearch.

tech.name: Meilisearch
tech.notes: Typo-tolerant search engine for product and site search, with a simple HTTP API.

tech.name: Typesense
tech.notes: In-memory, typo-tolerant search engine.

tech.name: Auth.js
tech.notes: Authentication for web frameworks (formerly NextAuth.js): OAuth providers, email and credentials, sessions in a database or JWT.

tech.name: Better Auth
tech.notes: Framework-agnostic TypeScript auth library with plugins for 2FA and organisations.

tech.name: Keycloak
tech.notes: Self-hosted identity provider: OpenID Connect, SAML, users, federation (a CNCF project).

tech.name: Clerk
tech.notes: Hosted authentication and user management with prebuilt UI components; priced by active users.

tech.name: Supabase Auth
tech.notes: Auth service (a GoTrue fork) issuing JWTs that Postgres row-level security can check.

tech.name: Auth0
tech.notes: Hosted identity platform from Okta: OIDC, social logins, enterprise SSO.

tech.name: Amazon Cognito
tech.notes: AWS user pools and identity federation.

tech.name: Firebase Authentication
tech.notes: Google's hosted auth with email, phone and social providers.

tech.name: Ory Kratos
tech.notes: Headless, API-first identity and user management server.

tech.name: django-allauth
tech.notes: Account registration, login and social accounts for Django.

tech.name: Devise
tech.notes: Authentication for Rails built on Warden.

tech.name: Spring Security
tech.notes: Authentication and authorisation for Spring applications, including OAuth2 resource servers.

tech.name: PyTorch
tech.notes: Deep-learning framework with eager execution and a compiler (torch.compile); now under the Linux Foundation.

tech.name: TensorFlow
tech.notes: Google's machine-learning framework; Keras is its high-level API; TF Serving and TFLite for deployment.

tech.name: Keras
tech.notes: High-level deep-learning API; Keras 3 runs on TensorFlow, JAX or PyTorch.

tech.name: scikit-learn
tech.notes: Classical machine learning in Python: regression, classification, clustering, pipelines.

tech.name: XGBoost
tech.notes: Gradient-boosted decision trees; strong on tabular data.

tech.name: Hugging Face Transformers
tech.notes: Pretrained transformer models with a common API for inference and fine-tuning.

tech.name: vLLM
tech.notes: High-throughput LLM inference server (PagedAttention) with an OpenAI-compatible API; needs GPUs for most models.

tech.name: Ollama
tech.notes: Runs open-weight language models locally behind an HTTP API.

tech.name: MLflow
tech.notes: Experiment tracking, a model registry and model packaging.

tech.name: Ray
tech.notes: Distributed compute for Python: data processing, training (Ray Train) and serving (Ray Serve).

tech.name: Feast
tech.notes: Feature store: one definition of features for offline training and online serving.

tech.name: BentoML
tech.notes: Packages models as HTTP services with batching and container builds.

tech.name: NVIDIA Triton Inference Server
tech.notes: Model server for many frameworks on GPU and CPU, with dynamic batching.

tech.name: ONNX Runtime
tech.notes: Cross-platform inference engine for models exported to ONNX.

tech.name: LangGraph
tech.notes: Builds stateful, multi-step LLM agents as graphs with checkpoints and human-in-the-loop pauses.

tech.name: LangChain
tech.notes: Integrations and building blocks for LLM applications: model wrappers, retrievers, tools.

tech.name: LlamaIndex
tech.notes: Data framework for retrieval-augmented generation: loaders, indexes, query engines.

tech.name: LiteLLM
tech.notes: One OpenAI-style interface to many model providers, plus a proxy with budgets and fallbacks.

tech.name: OpenAI API
tech.notes: Hosted GPT models, embeddings and tools; priced per token.

tech.name: Anthropic API
tech.notes: Hosted Claude models; priced per token.

tech.name: Ragas
tech.notes: Evaluation metrics for retrieval-augmented generation: faithfulness, answer relevance, context precision.

tech.name: promptfoo
tech.notes: Test and red-team prompts and LLM apps from a config file; runs in CI.

tech.name: Guardrails AI
tech.notes: Validates LLM inputs and outputs against validators (PII, toxicity, schemas).

tech.name: Evidently
tech.notes: Data drift, model quality and LLM evaluation reports and monitors.

tech.name: Apache Airflow
tech.notes: Schedules and monitors workflows written as Python DAGs.

tech.name: Dagster
tech.notes: Data orchestrator built around software-defined assets, with lineage and type checks.

tech.name: Prefect
tech.notes: Workflow orchestration from decorated Python functions.

tech.name: dbt
tech.notes: Transforms data inside the warehouse with version-controlled SQL models, tests and docs (dbt Core).

tech.name: Apache Spark
tech.notes: Distributed data processing engine for batch, SQL and streaming.

tech.name: Apache Flink
tech.notes: Stateful stream processing with event time and exactly-once state.

tech.name: pandas
tech.notes: DataFrames for in-memory data analysis in Python.

tech.name: Polars
tech.notes: Columnar DataFrame library in Rust with lazy queries; usually faster and lighter than pandas on large data.

tech.name: Jupyter
tech.notes: Notebooks that mix code, output and prose.

tech.name: Great Expectations
tech.notes: Declarative data-quality tests ('expectations') with generated reports.

tech.name: Apache Iceberg
tech.notes: Open table format for large analytic tables with schema evolution and time travel.

tech.name: Delta Lake
tech.notes: Open table format adding ACID transactions to Parquet files.

tech.name: Debezium
tech.notes: Change data capture: streams database row changes into Kafka.

tech.name: Google BigQuery
tech.notes: Serverless data warehouse; priced by data scanned or reserved slots.

tech.name: Snowflake
tech.notes: Cloud data warehouse separating storage from compute warehouses.

tech.name: Amazon Redshift
tech.notes: AWS columnar data warehouse, provisioned or serverless.

tech.name: Metabase
tech.notes: Self-service dashboards and questions over SQL databases.

tech.name: Apache Superset
tech.notes: Open-source BI: SQL editor, charts, dashboards.

tech.name: Docker
tech.notes: Builds and runs containers from Dockerfiles; the engine (Moby) is open source, Docker Desktop has paid tiers for larger companies.

tech.name: Docker Compose
tech.notes: Defines multi-container apps in a YAML file for local development and single hosts.

tech.name: Kubernetes
tech.notes: Container orchestration: scheduling, service discovery, rollouts, autoscaling. Operationally heavy for small teams.

tech.name: Helm
tech.notes: Package manager for Kubernetes: templated charts with values per environment.

tech.name: Terraform
tech.notes: Infrastructure as code in HCL with providers for every major cloud; relicensed to BUSL in 1.6.

tech.name: OpenTofu
tech.notes: Open-source fork of Terraform 1.5 under the Linux Foundation, compatible with its providers.

tech.name: Pulumi
tech.notes: Infrastructure as code in general-purpose languages.

tech.name: Ansible
tech.notes: Agentless configuration management over SSH with YAML playbooks.

tech.name: NGINX
tech.notes: Web server, reverse proxy and load balancer.

tech.name: Caddy
tech.notes: Web server and reverse proxy with automatic HTTPS certificates.

tech.name: Traefik
tech.notes: Reverse proxy that configures its routes from Docker labels or Kubernetes resources.

tech.name: Envoy
tech.notes: L7 proxy used as an edge gateway and in service meshes; gRPC-aware.

tech.name: Kong Gateway
tech.notes: API gateway on NGINX with plugins for auth, rate limits and logging.

tech.name: AWS Lambda
tech.notes: Functions run on demand and billed per request and duration; 15-minute limit per invocation.

tech.name: Cloudflare Workers
tech.notes: Functions on V8 isolates at Cloudflare's edge, with KV, D1 (SQLite), R2 and Queues beside them.

tech.name: HashiCorp Vault
tech.notes: Secrets management, dynamic credentials and encryption as a service.

tech.name: SOPS
tech.notes: Encrypts values inside YAML/JSON/env files so secrets can live in git.

tech.name: age
tech.notes: Simple file encryption tool with small keys.

tech.name: A virtual machine
tech.notes: One Linux server you run yourself: cheap and simple, and you own patching, backups and uptime.

tech.name: GitHub Actions
tech.notes: CI/CD workflows in YAML inside GitHub repositories; free minutes for public repos and a monthly allowance for private ones.

tech.name: GitLab CI/CD
tech.notes: Pipelines defined in .gitlab-ci.yml; runners can be self-hosted.

tech.name: Jenkins
tech.notes: Self-hosted automation server with a large plugin ecosystem; pipelines in a Jenkinsfile.

tech.name: CircleCI
tech.notes: Hosted CI/CD with caching, parallelism and orbs.

tech.name: Argo CD
tech.notes: GitOps continuous delivery: keeps a Kubernetes cluster in sync with manifests in git.

tech.name: Flux
tech.notes: GitOps toolkit for Kubernetes (a CNCF project).

tech.name: Renovate
tech.notes: Opens pull requests that update dependencies, with grouping and schedules.

tech.name: GoReleaser
tech.notes: Builds, packages and publishes Go binaries (archives, Homebrew, containers).

tech.name: OpenTelemetry
tech.notes: Vendor-neutral APIs, SDKs and a collector for traces, metrics and logs.

tech.name: Prometheus
tech.notes: Pull-based metrics store with PromQL and alerting rules.

tech.name: Grafana
tech.notes: Dashboards and alerts over Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, SQL and more.

tech.name: Grafana Loki
tech.notes: Log aggregation that indexes labels, not full text.

tech.name: Grafana Tempo
tech.notes: Distributed tracing backend on object storage.

tech.name: Jaeger
tech.notes: Distributed tracing system (a CNCF project).

tech.name: Sentry
tech.notes: Error tracking with stack traces, releases and performance traces; hosted plans or self-hosted.

tech.name: Datadog
tech.notes: Hosted metrics, logs, traces and monitors; priced per host and per volume.

tech.name: Uptime Kuma
tech.notes: Self-hosted uptime monitoring with notifications.

tech.name: Playwright
tech.notes: Browser automation and end-to-end tests across Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, with auto-waiting.

tech.name: Cypress
tech.notes: End-to-end and component tests running inside the browser.

tech.name: Vitest
tech.notes: Unit test runner built on Vite with a Jest-compatible API.

tech.name: Jest
tech.notes: JavaScript test runner with mocking and snapshots.

tech.name: Testing Library
tech.notes: Tests UI the way a person uses it: queries by role, label and text.

tech.name: pytest
tech.notes: Python test framework with fixtures and plain assert statements.

tech.name: JUnit 5
tech.notes: The standard JVM test framework.

tech.name: xUnit.net
tech.notes: .NET unit testing framework.

tech.name: RSpec
tech.notes: Behaviour-driven testing for Ruby.

tech.name: PHPUnit
tech.notes: The standard PHP unit testing framework.

tech.name: Testcontainers
tech.notes: Starts real databases and brokers in throwaway containers for integration tests.

tech.name: Grafana k6
tech.notes: Load testing with scripts in JavaScript, run from a Go binary.

tech.name: Locust
tech.notes: Load testing with user behaviour written in Python.

tech.name: Hypothesis
tech.notes: Property-based testing: generates inputs and shrinks failures to the smallest example.

tech.name: Detox
tech.notes: Gray-box end-to-end tests for React Native apps.

tech.name: Jasmine + Karma
tech.notes: Angular's long-standing default unit test pair; newer Angular releases also offer other runners.

tech.name: Vercel
tech.notes: Hosting for front ends and serverless/edge functions with preview deployments per branch; made by the Next.js team.

tech.name: Netlify
tech.notes: Static and Jamstack hosting with functions, forms and deploy previews.

tech.name: Cloudflare
tech.notes: CDN, DNS and security, plus Pages, Workers, R2 storage and D1 for hosting apps.

tech.name: Fly.io
tech.notes: Runs containers as Firecracker micro-VMs in regions close to users.

tech.name: Render
tech.notes: Managed hosting for web services, workers, cron jobs and Postgres, deployed from git.

tech.name: Railway
tech.notes: Deploys services and databases from git or images with usage-based pricing.

tech.name: Heroku
tech.notes: Platform as a service with buildpacks, dynos and add-ons (Salesforce).

tech.name: Amazon Web Services
tech.notes: The largest public cloud: compute, managed databases, queues, storage and more, billed by use.

tech.name: Google Cloud
tech.notes: Public cloud with Cloud Run, GKE, BigQuery and Vertex AI.

tech.name: Microsoft Azure
tech.notes: Public cloud with App Service, AKS, Functions and Entra ID.

tech.name: Oracle Cloud
tech.notes: Public cloud whose Always Free tier includes Arm VMs and an autonomous database.

tech.name: DigitalOcean
tech.notes: Droplets (VMs), App Platform, managed databases and Kubernetes.

tech.name: Hetzner Cloud
tech.notes: Low-cost VMs and dedicated servers in Europe and the US.

tech.name: GitHub Pages
tech.notes: Static sites served from a repository; no server-side code.

tech.name: Firebase
tech.notes: Google's app platform: hosting, auth, Firestore, Cloud Functions, messaging.

tech.name: Amazon CloudFront
tech.notes: AWS content delivery network.

tech.name: App Store and Google Play
tech.notes: Where mobile apps are distributed; each release passes the store's review.

tech.name: Package registries (PyPI, npm, crates.io)
tech.notes: Where libraries and CLIs are published; releases are immutable once published.
